newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens to hike investments in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens to hike investments in 1997.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday it expected to hike investments sharply in 1997 compared with 1996.
"The expenditure on investment will increase considerably in 1997 compared with 1996. This relates both to investments in fixed assets and to acquisitions," Hoogovens said in a statement.
It said that during the course of 1997 it hoped to make a decision to invest in an integrated casting and rolling installation.
"Important investments in acquisitions relate to the acquisition of the remaining 50 percent of shares in Hille & Mueller and the planned joint venture with Usines Gustave Boel," Hoogovens added.
